say:1:1033450001:1.text: Of course! Whenever there was danger, Parisa was always at the front.
say:1:1033450001:1.source_cn: 当然，之前遭遇危险时，帕瑞莎总是冲在最前面。
say:1:1033450001:1.male: Of course! Whenever there was danger, Parisa was always at the front.
say:1:1033450001:1.female: Of course! Whenever there was danger, Parisa was always at the front.

say:2:1033450002:1.text: Had I not been away on patrol, I would've stepped forth to defend her when Eomir pushed her out of power.
say:2:1033450002:1.source_cn: 要不是伊米尔夺走帕瑞莎指挥权的时候，我在外围巡逻，一定...
say:2:1033450002:1.male: Had I not been away on patrol, I would've stepped forth to defend her when Eomir pushed her out of power.
say:2:1033450002:1.female: Had I not been away on patrol, I would've stepped forth to defend her when Eomir pushed her out of power.

say:3:1033450003:1.text: Eomir was very good at public speaking and motivating others...
say:3:1033450003:1.source_cn: 伊米尔他……确实很善于演讲和激励人心。
say:3:1033450003:1.male: Eomir was very good at public speaking and motivating others...
say:3:1033450003:1.female: Eomir was very good at public speaking and motivating others...

say:4:1033450004:1.text: But look what he has done! His eloquence is a nasty venom that corrupts hearts.
say:4:1033450004:1.source_cn: 可看看他做了什么？他的雄辩是丑恶的毒液，只会腐化人心。
say:4:1033450004:1.male: But look what he has done! His eloquence is a nasty venom that corrupts hearts.
say:4:1033450004:1.female: But look what he has done! His eloquence is a nasty venom that corrupts hearts.
